faq.question: Do I need any prior experience?
faq.answer: No! Our programs are designed for absolute beginners and experienced operators alike.

faq.question: What equipment do I need?
faq.answer: Just a computer or smartphone to start. Optional equipment recommendations provided as you advance.

faq.question: How long does it take to learn?
faq.answer: Most students achieve basic proficiency in 2-3 months with regular practice.

faq.question: Are the certifications recognized?
faq.answer: Yes, our certifications are recognized by amateur radio organizations worldwide.

faq.question: Can I cancel anytime?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer flexible subscription plans with no long-term commitments.
